3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 474 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504, 506 of IPC, Police Station Kokhraj, District Kaushambi, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and has apprehension of his arrest.
He has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.
Learned counsel has further stated that the FIR is delayed by about seven months and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
There is no injury report to corroborate the prosecution story.
The present FIR is a counterblast to the FIR No.574 of 2022 which was instituted by the wife of the applicant against the family members of the informant.
6. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal history.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

7. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail on the ground that the application u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C. was moved on 06.06.2023 although it is also delayed by about three months.
However, learned AGA could not dispute the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

8. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98"
and also taking into consideration the fact of delay in lodging the FIR and there being another FIR instituted against the son of the informant by the wife of the applicant, I find it a fit case to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail.
